items.title: Hentoff Nat — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Ken was part of Red Allen’s band. He played with Red Allen...

ctx.x: Talk about him, because he’s someone who has been pretty much erased.

Ken was part of Red Allen’s band. He played with Red Allen – speaking of joy. Red privately was very shy, sort of reticent, but he was a showman, as many of these people were, because you had to entertain to make a living. He really lived that thing. It came out in his music. By the way, having come out of the New Orleans band music, the old New Orleans style stuff, it was Miles who told me that he heard stuff in Red’s playing, when Miles came to New York, that later became part of what is loosely called modern…
